description: Care Pathway Builder - A condition-agnostic tool (starting with OAB) that lets providers select and sequence treatments into a pathway, generating a nurse protocol (clipboard → EMR) and patient education PDF packet. Persisted via anonymous key with creatorToken write protection.

userStories.title: Treatment catalog and types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the OAB treatment catalog data structure and TypeScript types so all downstream components have a stable foundation to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/pages/care-pathway/types.ts with Treatment, Step, Pathway, Exclusion, and Condition types

Treatment type includes: id, name, tier ('first-line'|'second-line'|'third-line'|'adjunctive'), category, defaultDuration, doseOptions (string[] for medications), requiresProvider (boolean), pdfHandoutPath (string|null)
Step type includes: treatmentId, sequence, duration, dose, notes, followUp, escalationTrigger, transitionText (all optional strings except treatmentId and sequence)
Create src/pages/care-pathway/config/treatmentCatalog.ts as a generic catalog loader that accepts a Condition config

Create src/pages/care-pathway/config/conditions/oab.ts with the full OAB treatment catalog: all first-line behavioral (7 items), second-line pharmacotherapy with separate entries per dose (beta-3 agonists, antimuscarinics, combination, topical estrogen), third-line procedures (Botox requiresProvider:true, PTNS requiresProvider:false, implantable tibial requiresProvider:true, sacral neuromodulation requiresProvider:true), adjunctive (pessary, incontinence products)
Create Zod validation schema in types.ts mirroring the pathway data structure: treatmentId non-empty, sequence positive int, text fields HTML-stripped and max 500 chars, exclusions array validated
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Separate catalog entries per dose (e.g., vibegron 75mg and mirabegron 25mg are distinct items). requiresProvider flag replaces tier-based escalation boundary. PTNS is third-line but requiresProvider:false.

userStories.title: API client and React Query hooks
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the API client and data-fetching hooks so the builder can save, load, and update pathways.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/api/carePathway.ts using apiClient from src/api/client.ts (Axios with JWT interceptors)
Implement savePathway(data) → POST /api/care-pathway, returns { key, creatorToken }
Implement getPathway(key) → GET /api/care-pathway/{key}, returns pathway data
Implement updatePathway(key, data, creatorToken) → PUT /api/care-pathway/{key} with creatorToken in X-Creator-Token header
Create src/pages/care-pathway/hooks/usePathway.ts with React Query hooks: useGetPathway(key), useSavePathway(), useUpdatePathway()
creatorToken stored in localStorage keyed by pathway key on save
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Server generates the key (not client-side). creatorToken is a UUID required for PUT to prevent accidental nurse edits. Backend endpoints don't exist yet — these hooks will work once the backend is built.

userStories.title: Page scaffold with useReducer state management
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the page scaffold with routing and state management so components can be built incrementally.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/pages/care-pathway/index.tsx as the main page component
Add routes to src/App.tsx: /care-pathway (builder) and /care-pathway/:key (lookup)
Implement useReducer at page level with actions: addStep, removeStep, reorderStep (renumbers all sequences), updateStep, addExclusion, removeExclusion
reorderStep action must renumber all sequence fields after drag-drop reorder
Two-panel grid layout: 340px left panel + flexible right panel (matching wireframe)
React Router useBlocker for unsaved changes navigation warning
Empty state: dashed border in right panel with text 'Select treatments from the menu to build a pathway'
Minimum viewport check: below 1024px show 'This tool is designed for desktop use'
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use useReducer for builder working state (NOT Redux). React Query only for save/load mutations. useBlocker instead of beforeunload for cross-browser support.

userStories.title: Treatment menu component
userStories.description: As a provider, I want to see all available treatments organized by tier so I can select which ones this patient is a candidate for.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/pages/care-pathway/components/TreatmentMenu.tsx
Displays treatments from OAB catalog organized by tier sections: First-Line Behavioral, Second-Line Pharmacotherapy, Third-Line Procedures, Adjunctive
Each tier has a colored label header
Each treatment is a checkbox item — checking immediately dispatches addStep to the reducer
Selected treatments show green check styling
Treatments with requiresProvider:true show a small indicator icon
Excluded treatments section at bottom with strikethrough styling and reason text
Provider can add exclusions by right-clicking or via a small exclude button on each treatment, with a reason input
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Excluded treatments appear inline in their tier with strikethrough AND in a summary section at bottom. Checking a treatment appends it to the pathway with smooth scroll-into-view.

userStories.title: Pathway builder with drag-drop StepCards
userStories.description: As a provider, I want to drag and reorder treatment steps and configure timing, doses, and notes for each step.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/pages/care-pathway/components/PathwayBuilder.tsx as the right panel container
Create src/pages/care-pathway/components/StepCard.tsx as individual draggable step
Implement react-dnd drag-and-drop reordering (reference pattern from src/pages/combine-pdf/modules/PDFCombine/PDFSelections.tsx)
StepCard always shows: step number, treatment name, tier badge, drag handle (left), remove button (right)
StepCard expanded by default: duration dropdown ('2 weeks', '4 weeks', '4-6 weeks', '6-8 weeks', 'Ongoing', custom), dose text input (pre-filled from catalog for medications)
StepCard collapsed by default (click to expand): notes textarea (200 char max), follow-up text input, escalation trigger text input
Steps with requiresProvider:true have red left border and '(provider only)' label
Second-line medication steps have orange left border
Unchecking a treatment with edited fields shows confirmation dialog: 'Remove [treatment]? Custom settings will be lost.'

Inter-step connectors between cards: editable text with presets dropdown ('Then →', 'Concurrent with above →', 'If previous insufficient →', 'ESCALATE TO PROVIDER →', custom). Auto-generated defaults based on tier transitions
All text inputs enforce maxLength (notes: 200, dose: 100, duration: 50, transitionText: 200)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: DnD is pattern-level reuse from PDF combiner, not direct component reuse — pathway steps have richer UI. Connector presets auto-fill: same-tier='Then →', tier change upward='If previous insufficient →', to requiresProvider treatment='ESCALATE TO PROVIDER →'.

userStories.title: Nurse protocol text output with clipboard
userStories.description: As a provider, I want to generate a structured nurse protocol text and copy it to the clipboard so I can paste it into the EMR.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/pages/care-pathway/components/NurseProtocolOutput.tsx

Generates ASCII-safe structured text following the template: header with key/condition/dates, numbered steps with tier/duration/dose/follow-up/notes/escalation trigger, transition text between steps, excluded treatments section, footer with key
No unicode box-drawing characters — use ASCII-safe formatting only (dashes, equals signs)
HTML tags stripped from all text fields before rendering
Expandable preview: starts in a bottom tab panel, can expand to full-height view
Copy Nurse Protocol button uses useCopyToClipboard hook from src/hooks/useCopyToClipboard.ts
Copy feedback: button changes to 'Copied ✓' with green background for 2-3 seconds
Copy Key button next to the pathway key display
@media print CSS for clean, no-UI-chrome printed output
Protocol output disabled (button grayed) when pathway has zero steps
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The protocol text IS the product — it goes directly into the EMR. ASCII-safe is critical because unicode may render as garbage in some EMR systems. Expandable preview is important because the bottom tab is too cramped for reviewing before copy.

userStories.title: Patient education PDF output
userStories.description: As a provider, I want to assemble a patient education PDF packet with handouts for each selected treatment so the nurse can give it to the patient.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/pages/care-pathway/components/PatientEducationOutput.tsx
Uses pdf-lib merge pattern from src/libs/pdf-libs.ts
Cover page using a fillable PDF template (not generated from scratch with pdf-lib): shows 'Patient Education Materials' header, pathway key, date, list of included treatments
Handouts assembled in pathway sequence order
Per-PDF try/catch: if a handout PDF fails to load, insert a placeholder page noting 'Education materials for [treatment] — discuss with your provider' and show a toast warning
Treatments without linked PDFs (pdfHandoutPath is null) get the same placeholder page
Build Patient Packet button disabled when pathway has zero steps
Downloaded file named 'patient-education-{key}.pdf'
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Cover page uses a fillable PDF template to avoid 2-4 hours of pdf-lib layout work. Some OAB treatments won't have PDFs yet — placeholder pages handle this gracefully.

userStories.title: Save pathway and key management
userStories.description: As a provider, I want to save a pathway and get an anonymous key so the nurse can look it up later.
acceptanceCriteria: Save button in the builder header area
On save: validate pathway data with Zod schema, strip HTML from text fields, then call savePathway API
Display returned key prominently with 'Copy Key' button
Store creatorToken in localStorage keyed by pathway key
Unsaved changes indicator: Save button shows dot + 'Unsaved' label when state differs from last save
After save: show completion summary 'Pathway saved. Share key {key} with your nurse.'
Editing existing pathway (loaded by key): show 'Editing existing pathway' badge + Created/Updated timestamps, use updatePathway API with creatorToken
Save disabled when steps array is empty
API error on save: toast 'Could not save pathway. Your selections are preserved — try again.' and retain local state
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Server generates the key. creatorToken prevents accidental nurse edits via PUT. Zod validation mirrors the Pydantic model on the backend.

userStories.title: Read-only pathway lookup for nurses
userStories.description: As a nurse, I want to look up a pathway by key and see a clear, read-only protocol so I can follow the treatment plan without accidentally editing it.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/pages/care-pathway/components/PathwayLookup.tsx
Route /care-pathway/:key renders the lookup view (not the editable builder)
Shows the nurse protocol text prominently (main content area, not a small tab)
Shows patient education list with download button
Print button for clean printed output
No edit controls visible — completely read-only
Loading state: skeleton loader, key visible immediately from URL
404 state: 'Pathway not found. Check the key and try again.' with key input field for manual entry
5xx state: 'Service temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.' (distinct from 404)
Also accessible by navigating to /care-pathway and entering a key manually
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Nurse and provider see DIFFERENT views. The nurse view is read-only with the protocol text front and center. The provider editable builder is only at /care-pathway (no :key param).

userStories.title: Home page integration
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the Care Pathway Builder on the home page tool grid so I can navigate to it.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Care Pathway Builder card to the home page tool grid in src/pages/home/
Card shows tool name, brief description, and 'OAB' as the available condition
Card links to /care-pathway
Follows existing card styling patterns from other tools
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow the pattern of existing tool cards (consent form generator, scheduling, coverage search, etc.).

userStories.title: Unit tests for protocol formatter and validation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need automated tests for the critical paths: nurse protocol text generation, Zod validation, and step sequencing.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests for nurse protocol formatter: empty pathway, single step, multiple steps, step with escalation trigger, step with/without dose, exclusions rendering, transition text rendering, ASCII-safe output (no unicode), HTML stripped from fields
Tests for Zod validation: valid data passes, missing treatmentId fails, negative sequence fails, HTML in notes is stripped, exceeds maxLength fails, empty steps array fails
Tests for step sequencing: after reorder all sequences renumbered, add step gets correct sequence, remove step renumbers remaining
Tests for treatment catalog: all treatments have required fields, no duplicate IDs, medication treatments have dose options, requiresProvider flag set correctly (PTNS=false, Botox=true)
All tests pass
userStories.notes: The protocol formatter is the most critical output — it goes into clinical EMR records. Test edge cases thoroughly. See test plan at ~/.gstack/projects/stuboo-practicetools-web/jrs-feature-oab-care-pathway-test-plan-20260325.md
